mapper.insert: INSERT INTO debate_sessions (user_id, topic, mode, status, peak_reached) VALUES (#{userId}, #{topic}, #{mode}, #{status}, #{peakReached})
mapper.update: UPDATE debate_sessions SET status = #{status}, stopped_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'STOPPED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE stopped_at END WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO debate_messages (debate_session_id, speaker, round_no, content) VALUES (#{debateSessionId}, #{speaker}, #{roundNo}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT id, debate_session_id, speaker, round_no, content, created_at FROM debate_messages WHERE debate_session_id = #{debateSessionId} ORDER BY round_no ASC, id ASC
